No value pattern can distinguish this mutant because:
- Every position 0 to size-1 is correctly written in both versions
- The transformation applied is identical (hardtanh with same min/max)
- Overlapping writes are benign (same value written)

The mutation creates redundant overlapping writes but produces **bitwise identical output** for all inputs. The `if (pos < size)` guard ensures correctness at boundaries.
